messages:
sam_p: kicking off PRD thread for "Attn heuristics + KV cache routing"…

sam_p: goal: reduce 95p end-to-end latency for chat with >8k context while keeping per-token compute cost neutral or better.

carla: quick question — do we consider kernel changes (attention tiling) or a middleware heuristic that rewrites attention windows per-request?

dinesh: both have tradeoffs. kernel changes give us better worst-case but require major QA. heuristic layer is faster to ship but might not help long-seq transformers.

mira: customer asks: "can we avoid cold-KV recompute on model switch?" Acceptance criteria should include no rewarm >1s for model variant fallback.

sam_p: acceptance criteria proposal:
- 95p latency down by >=20% on long-context chat (>=8k) for hosted tier
- no more than 5% increase in average token cost
- cache invalidation window documented and tested
- fallback path within 1s for model variant swap

carla: edge cases:
- sequences with many short turns (lots of small prefixes)
- tool-calls that mutate context mid-stream
- quantized kernels where scratch memory differs

nate: infra-bot: perf job queued -> `perf-ci/long-context/1782109876`

mira: scope negotiation: if kernel rewrite -> split into 2 phases: 1) heuristic routing + KV-aware prefix caching (MVP), 2) kernel refactor (opt-in rollout) with canary and perf benchmarks.

dinesh: MVP technical notes:
```
heuristic rules:
- if seq_len>2048 and avg_turn_len>128 -> prefer tiled-attn simulator
- maintain per-session KV checksum -> cacheable across model variants if arch-compatible
```

carla: rollout plan for MVP:
- canary 5% dedicated -> monitor 95p and token cost by route
- if 95p regresses -> rollback and enable kernel-refactor flag for canary only

sam_p: launch criteria:
- signoff from eng-runtime, eng-sre, and product
- automated e2e tests covering tool-call invalidation and model-fallback
- perf dashboards + alerting (95p >= 20% improvement)

mira: risks:
- unbounded KV memory growth for long-lived sessions
- subtle correctness across quantized model family
- coupling heuristics to model catalog -> needs robust compatibility matrix

dinesh: mitigation:
- leak detector + per-tenant KV TTL
- compatibility matrix generator (model_variant -> kv-layout hash)
- perf regression suite for quantized and fp16 variants

sam_p: action items:
- @carla draft PRD with acceptance criteria and MVP scope by EOD Thurs
- @dinesh prototype per-session checksum and TTL sketch
- @mira prepare canary monitoring playbook

carla: ack :thumbsup: 

mira: I'll add the monitoring dashboards and alert thresholds to the PRD

nate: perf job posted, will share initial numbers tomorrow

sam_p: thanks all — ping here when PRD is up so we can loop in security and customer-success for compliance and rollout comms.
